candidateObjectiveEnglish: Ask a practice partner for help with an English word, ask what inspection means, then repeat it and thank the partner.
grammarExplanationEnglish: English nouns inspection, protection and construction share spelling with French but differ in pronunciation. "I need help" uses need with an uncountable noun. In questions, do/does comes before the subject and the following verb stays in its base form: "Do you speak English?" and "What does inspection mean?"
